about: Measured choice of the verse each of the 400 most frequent words is heard from (brief 16, piece 3). For each word, up to six of its best-placed occurrences (pause-ranked) were cut from Mishary Alafasy's recitation (verses.quran.com/Alafasy, Quran.com word timings) with the app's own cut rules (src/lib/wordAudio.ts, clipOf) and the occurrence whose louder edge is quietest was kept; an occurrence whose published timing is under 0.25 s loses to any longer one. Only the choice and its measurement are stored: no audio, no timings. Fields: ref and hit (word index) chosen, loudness at the start and end cut in dB, and the pause-ranked first pick with its loudness, for comparison. Measured 2026-11-23 in a browser (Web Audio decode, 20 ms RMS).
